# Medieval Village Pack

The six GLB files in this directory are from the [Poly Pizza Medieval Village Pack](https://poly.pizza/bundle/Medieval-Village-Pack-NsHhjhlrfY), which lists the pack as free for personal and commercial use under CC0/Public Domain.

Included models: `house.glb`, `house-alt.glb`, `inn.glb`, `blacksmith.glb`, `barracks.glb`, and `gazebo.glb`.
